name: Wedge Salad With Buttermilk-Blue Cheese Dressing
author: Amanda Hesser

ingredients.raw: ¼ pound smoked slab bacon, cut into ¼-inch cubes
6 slices white bread, crusts removed and cut in half
ingredients.preparation: crusts removed and cut in half

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
ingredients.item: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ heads iceberg lettuce, trimmed and cut through the core into 12 wedges
ingredients.preparation: trimmed and cut through the core into 12 wedges

ingredients.raw: 3 scallions, green part only, cut in thin slices on a sharp bias
ingredients.preparation: green part only, cut in thin slices on a sharp bias

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, reserving the skillet with bacon fat. Brush bread slices on both sides with bacon fat. Place bread on a baking sheet, and bake until golden brown, turning once, about 5 minutes a side. Remove from oven, and reserve.
In a small bowl, combine buttermilk, cheese, lemon juice, vinegar, shallots, parsley and cayenne. Whisk to blend. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
On each of 6 plates, place 2 slices of bread. Arrange a lettuce wedge on top of each bread slice.
Pour dressing over the wedges. Sprinkle with bacon and scallions. Serve.
